cards.claim: Michael Myers is associated with American football, as evidenced by his participation in the AFC Championship game, making tackles, and playing for teams like the Broncos and Bengals.
cards.quote: including the AFC Championship game versus the Pittsburgh Steelers where he made tackles. He made 50 tackles, while helping the Broncos finish with a 13-3 record which clinched the AFC West title. Myers started all 16 games for the Broncos and had a career high 57 combined tackles (37, 20). He had 2 sacks, 2 passes defensed and forced a fumble.
